name: Velocity Pro Running Shoe
description: A lightweight daily trainer with a responsive foam midsole and a breathable engineered mesh upper. Built for tempo runs, long runs and everything in between.

name: AeroLite Running Jacket
description: A wind- and water-resistant shell that packs into its own pocket. Reflective details keep you visible on early morning and late evening runs.

name: Pulse GPS Sports Watch
description: Track pace, distance, heart rate and recovery with built-in GPS and up to 14 days of battery life. Water resistant for swim and rain sessions.

name: Adjustable Dumbbell Set
description: Quick-change dumbbells that replace a full rack. Twist the handle to switch weights in seconds and save space in your home gym.

name: Grip Yoga Mat
description: A non-slip mat with cushioned support for yoga, stretching and floor workouts. Easy to clean and light enough to carry to class.

name: Resistance Band Set
description: Five bands from light to extra heavy for strength, mobility and warm-up routines. Comes with a carry bag so you can train anywhere.

name: Match Pro Football
description: A thermally bonded match ball with a consistent flight path and a soft touch. Suitable for natural and artificial grass. Currently out of stock.

name: Court Grip Basketball
description: A composite leather ball with deep channels for reliable grip on indoor and outdoor courts.

name: DryFit Training Jersey
description: A quick-drying training top that moves sweat away from your skin. Ideal for team practice, match warm-ups and the gym.

name: Trail Hiking Backpack
description: A ventilated 28 litre pack with a padded hip belt, rain cover and hydration sleeve for full-day hikes.

name: Insulated Sports Bottle
description: Double-wall stainless steel keeps drinks cold for 24 hours. Leak-proof lid with a one-hand sports cap.

name: Ridge Trekking Poles
description: Lightweight carbon poles with quick-lock adjustment and cork grips. Fold down small enough to clip to your pack.
